note: A storyboard picks a preset with "voice": "<preset>" or overrides fields with "voice": { "preset": "<preset>", "speed": 1.15 }. Per-line overrides: line.voice. Providers: kokoro (local, .venv), qwen3 and chatterbox (local, Apple MLX, .venv-qwen). All run offline after the first model download. See hf/README.md for how to add another provider. Grades are the Kokoro project's own (hexgrad/Kokoro-82M VOICES.md, checked 2026-10-06; A is best). They are a guide, not a substitute for listening.
